quarterly_data.signal: Ferrotec: amid continued growth in demand, its bases in China and Malaysia - including metal processing - are already operating at full capacity, and securing enough production capacity to meet domestic demand has become a key challenge. Ishikawa Factory No. 3 (fine ceramics for semiconductor manufacturing equipment) began operation in July 2025 under its 'Return to Japan' strategy; the board resolved on August 17, 2026 to acquire adjacent land of 16,826.74 m2 in Kawakita-machi, Ishikawa, and the company will begin studying construction of a 'Factory No. 4' for ceramics and metal processing (investment, floor area and start timing to be announced once finalized). Impact on fiscal year ending December 2026 results expected to be minor.
